en-US.-I affiche les en-têtes ; retirez -I pou: -I displays headers; remove -I to save the content.
en-US.-c : indiquez un nombre de requêtes de 1: -c: enter a request count from 1 to 100.
en-US.Affichage limité à 32 Kio. Utilisez -o f: Display limited to 32 KiB. Use -o file to download the full content.
Shows IPv4, subnet mask, gateway and DNS. Changing routes is not supported.
en-US.Affiche l'espace libre et la capacité du: Shows free space and capacity of the volume containing the folder; uses the current folder by default.
Shows the OS date and time.
en-US.Affiche la mémoire disponible et le plus: Shows available memory and the largest allocatable block.
en-US.Affiche le dernier composant d'un chemin: Shows the last component of a path.
Shows the parent folder of a path.
en-US.Affiche le nom du réseau et l'adresse IP: Shows the network name and IPv4 address, or the disconnected state.
en-US.Affiche le réseau Wi-Fi, IPv4, masque, p: Shows Wi-Fi network, IPv4, subnet mask, gateway, DNS and signal. Aliases: ifconfig, ip addr, ip route.
en-US.Affiche le type, la taille en octets et: Shows the type, size in bytes and modification date of each path.
en-US.Affiche les dernières lignes. -n : de 1: Shows the last lines. -n: 1 to 500 lines; default 10. Maximum retained: 64 KiB.
en-US.Affiche les fichiers texte dans l'ordre: Shows text files in the specified order.
en-US.Affiche les paramètres séparés par des e: Shows arguments separated by spaces. -n omits the final newline.
en-US.Affiche les premières lignes. -n : de 1: Shows the first lines. -n: 1 to 500 lines; default 10.
en-US.Affiche les secondes écoulées depuis le: Shows the seconds elapsed since startup.
en-US.Affiche les variables et PWD, le dossier: Shows variables and PWD, the current folder.
en-US.Affiche octets hexadécimaux et texte. -n: Shows hexadecimal bytes and text. -n: 1 to 65536 bytes, default 256; -s: starting byte offset.
en-US.Affiche statut HTTP, certificat HTTPS vé: Shows HTTP status, verified HTTPS certificate and useful audit headers. -L follows up to 5 redirects; -T limits total time, default 10 seconds.
en-US.Affiche un format : %s insère un paramèt: Prints a format: %s inserts an argument, %% a percent sign, \n a newline and \t a tab.
en-US.Affiche une réponse HTTP (32 Kio maximum: Shows an HTTP response (up to 32 KiB), or saves it with -o. -I requests headers; -L follows redirects; -T limits total time. HTTPS verifies the certificate and hostname.
en-US.Affiche une suite d'entiers croissants,: Shows ascending integers, one per line. Start: 1 by default; maximum 10000 values.
en-US.Alias de dns : résout un nom DNS en IPv4: Alias for dns: resolves a DNS name to IPv4.
en-US.Alias de netinfo : affiche la configurat: Alias for netinfo: shows the current network configuration.
en-US.Alias de tcp. -z teste la connexion sans: Alias for tcp. -z tests the connection without sending data. This client does not open an interactive session.
en-US.Attend une durée de 0 à 3600 secondes ;: Waits from 0 to 3600 seconds; use a decimal point for fractions. Ctrl+C interrupts the wait.
en-US.Calcule l'empreinte SHA-256 de chaque fi: Calculates the SHA-256 hash of each file, on SD or USB.
en-US.Calcule la taille des fichiers d'un doss: Calculates the total file size of a folder, including subfolders and hidden files.
en-US.Ce terminal ne prend pas en charge les t: This terminal does not support pipes |, background jobs & or $(command) substitution.
en-US.Ces observations ne prouvent pas à elles: These observations alone do not prove a vulnerability.
en-US.Change de dossier. Sans paramètre : raci: Changes folder. No argument: SD root. .. denotes the parent; /USB denotes the USB drive.
en-US.Chemins : /Documents sur SD, /USB/Docume: Paths: /Documents on SD, /USB/Documents on USB; downloads: sd:/ or usb:/.
en-US.Cherche récursivement jusqu'à 16 niveaux: Searches recursively up to 16 levels. -name filters names; enclose patterns in single quotes.
en-US.Cherche un texte littéral. -i ignore la: Searches for literal text. -i ignores ASCII case; -n shows line numbers. No matches: exit code 1.
en-US.Compare deux fichiers, indique le premie: Compares two files, reports the first different byte and returns 1 if they differ.
en-US.Compte les sauts de ligne, mots et octet: Counts newlines, words and bytes in each file.
en-US.Content-Security-Policy absente : à exam: Content-Security-Policy is absent: review this for HTML pages.
en-US.Copie un fichier vers un fichier ou doss: Copies a file to a file or folder. The previous destination stays intact if the copy fails.
en-US.Crée les dossiers. -p crée aussi les par: Creates folders. -p also creates missing parents and accepts an existing folder.
en-US.Crée un fichier vide s'il n'existe pas ;: Creates an empty file if absent; preserves an existing file's content.
en-US.Destination invalide. Utilisez sd:/Dossi: Invalid destination. Use sd:/Folder/file or usb:/Folder/file.
en-US.Définit une variable ; nom=valeur est au: Sets a variable; name=value is also accepted. Use $name or ${name}. Maximum: 32 variables.
en-US.Déplace ou renomme un fichier ou dossier: Moves or renames a file or folder on the same volume. Refuses to overwrite an existing destination.
en-US.Efface l'affichage du terminal ; conserv: Clears the terminal display; preserves history and variables.
en-US.Exécute un script dans le terminal coura: Runs a script in the current terminal, like source. Folder and variable changes persist.
Runs a script in the current terminal. $0 to $9 contain its path and arguments. Maximum size: 32 KiB.
en-US.HSTS absent : le serveur n'impose pas HT: HSTS is absent: the server does not require browsers to use HTTPS.
en-US.Impossible de créer le fichier temporair: Cannot create the temporary file. Check the folder and free space.
en-US.Indiquez le fichier de destination après: Specify the destination file after -o or -O.
en-US.Indiquez un hôte, puis le port ou la lis: Specify a host, followed by the port or port list if required.
en-US.Indiquez une URL http:// ou https:// val: Specify a valid http:// or https:// URL without a username or password.
The destination is not a file.
en-US.La destination vient d'être créée par un: Another operation has just created the destination.
en-US.La racine du support ne peut pas être su: The volume root cannot be deleted.
en-US.Le fichier existe déjà. Choisissez un au: The file already exists. Choose another name or add --overwrite.
en-US.Liste le dossier courant ou indiqué. -a: Lists the current or specified folder. -a includes hidden files; -l shows type and size.
en-US.Liste les commandes ; ajoutez un nom pou: Lists commands; add a name to see its parameters and an example.
en-US.Liste tous les chemins du dossier et de: Lists all paths in a folder and its subfolders, up to 16 levels.
Unknown or unsupported option. See help followed by the command name.
en-US.Placez les espaces entre guillemets. Mot: Quote paths containing spaces. Patterns: * ? [abc]. Variables: $name ${name} $PWD $?.
Port: enter an integer from 1 to 65535.
en-US.Ports : utilisez 22,80,443 ou 8000-8010: Ports: use 22,80,443 or 8000-8010; at most 1024 distinct ports.
en-US.Redirection reçue. Ajoutez -L pour la su: Redirect received. Add -L to follow it.
en-US.Renvoie le code 0 ; utile dans les condi: Returns exit code 0; useful in script conditions.
en-US.Renvoie le code 1 ; utile dans les condi: Returns exit code 1; useful in script conditions.
en-US.Réglez la date et l'heure avant d'utilis: Set the date and time before using HTTPS.
Repeats commands for each value. Maximum: 4 nested scripts or loops and 10000 commands per invocation.
en-US.Résout un nom DNS en IPv4, avec un délai: Resolves a DNS name to IPv4, with a 5-second timeout. Alias: nslookup.
en-US.Scripts : ; sépare les commandes, && con: Scripts: ; separates commands, && continues on success, || on failure. > replaces a file, >> appends text.
en-US.Stockage occupé. Réessayez après l'opéra: Storage is busy. Retry after the current operation.
en-US.Supprime immédiatement les chemins. -r i: Deletes paths immediately. -r includes folder contents. The volume root remains protected.
Deletes only empty folders. The volume root remains protected.
en-US.Teste l'ouverture d'un port TCP sans env: Tests a TCP port without sending data. Port: 1 to 65535; -w: connection timeout, default 1.5 seconds.
en-US.Teste les ports d'un appareil. Liste : 2: Tests a device's ports. List: 22,80,443 or 8000-8010; maximum 1024 ports. -w: timeout per port, default 1.5 seconds.
en-US.Teste les réponses ICMP. -c : 1 à 100 re: Tests ICMP replies. -c: 1 to 100 requests, default 4; -W: wait per request, default 1 second.
en-US.Teste une existence (-e), un fichier (-f: Tests existence (-e), a file (-f), a folder (-d) or two strings. True: 0; false: 1.
en-US.Télécharge sur SD ou USB. -O choisit le: Downloads to SD or USB. -O chooses the file; otherwise its name comes from the URL. -L follows redirects; -T limits total time (default 10 seconds). --overwrite replaces a file after success.
en-US.Téléchargement interrompu ou écriture im: Download interrupted or write failed; the previous file is preserved.
en-US.Un délai dépassé ne distingue pas un fil: A timeout cannot distinguish filtering from an unreachable device.
en-US.Une sauvegarde du téléchargement précéde: A backup from the previous download exists. Rename it before retrying.
